ticket.title: A handoff packet clears a pending-decision block and leaves the task Ready
ticket.description: Observed on GB-143: ask-decision marked the task Blocked, then storypole handoff <KEY> <AGENT> moved it to Ready while the Pending decision was still attached. An agent reading storypole next/ list would see a ready task whose architectural decision is unanswered. Handoff should preserve a Blocked state when a Pending decision exists (or recompute status from the decision set).

verification_receipt.summary: Fixed on storypole main at 03cab2c: handoff_task now returns the effective status and downgrades a requested Ready to Blocked while any DecisionStatus::Pending decision remains, matching the rule dag::is_task_dependency_ready already applies at claim time. The packet is still recorded and the lease released; Failed passes through unchanged because it is not claimable work. CLI prints the effective status and explains the downgrade on stderr; MCP storypole_handoff returns the status the task actually reached. New tests/handoff_decision_guard.rs has three cases (blocked handoff, post-resolution handoff, failure pass-through) and was proven to fail with the guard disabled: 'requesting ready must not win over an unanswered decision'. Gates: fmt clean, clippy --workspace --all-targets -D warnings clean, nextest 33/33.
